body:
This is my second time with 2fma, last time was a dose of somewhere around 10mg, and felt essentially nothing/placebo territory. This time I had once again consumed 3 energy drinks, 80mg caffeine each, totalling 240mg. This over the course of ~T-5:00 to ~T-1:00. I just finished lunch. I am working from home.
T+0:00: Take around 20mg using a rolling paper parachute, on an essentially empty stomach (Ive only eaten a little a few hours prior). Dosage is not at all reliable. Even though I have a scale advertised as mg accurate, it very clearly is not. When I have different rolling papers or containers to put the clumped up powder in it always reads a different amount (after tare-ing it to the container of course!). Going in I feel pretty good, and have been decently productive, which felt good too. Have a second parachute ready with what might just be ~10mg (might just be because of the unreliable scale). In case the first dose does nothing whatsoever, and I discover that in time for taking more to not meaningfully affect my sleep. The volume before I split out the 10mg looked similar to me to a crushed 20mg concerta ritalin pill powder. Surely they added 10mg of filler right? I did, of course, do my best to weigh the material. I am at least confident Im not taking some super high dose.
T+0:07: Feel the sudden need to pee, do so. Also drink a little water.
T+0:14: Slight anxiety, should get back to work.
T+0:44: I mean I might feel something, but it is incredibly subtle.
T+0:44: I mean I might feel something, but it is incredibly subtle.
Decide to take perhaps 10mg (again dont trust the scale, but its definitely not a lot, less than the first dose for sure too). Overall feel essentially the same as before the initial dose. Good but not better than baseline. Not meaningfully more focused. Task at hand is a little annoying, I perhaps feel less annoyed by it and more prepared to undertake the required work.
T+1:08: Ok definitely more talkative, thoughts more scattered, had to calm down to explain myself well. Id say I definitely feel it, but its also quite subtle still. Not bad at all. [Even looking back I dont think it was noticeable I was on a stimulant, nor that I actively calmed my amped up self down to the person I was talking to.]
T+1:11: Peed, penis is slightly smaller. Not as tiny as higher doses of stims/psychedelics, but noticeable. The more physical effects are often less ambiguous, especially on lower doses, so this is a nice confirmation to me its actually doing something now.
T+1:17: Took a shit.
T+1:25: Got distracted by my own thoughts, in relation to religion and how I dont view the existence of the universe/earth as evidence for the existence of a God. Going back to work.
T+2:02: Definitely active. Mild overall. Definitely more motivated. My lips just started to tingle a little. Music sounds great. Protest music made me think about taking this during/before a protest. I dont know if the decrease in inhibition would be altogether wise though in such a setting. Changing from YouTube videos in the background to music was definitely a good choice, much less distracting.
T+2:18: Slight constipated feeling. Still vibing on music. Coding goes nicely. Feel very focused and work is much more fun(?) this way. Usually want to do my work well, because I believe its important to do so. Now I feel like its a challenge (in a fun, game-like way) to do it really well. Same goal, motivation feels different.
T+2:40: Peed again, definitely need to pee more often than normal, given the amount Im drinking (maybe ~250ml water since T+0:00). And the fact I did most of my caffeine/energy drink related peeing prior.
T+3:22: Tingly lips again, in call again for work. Perhaps caused by being a little more alert and more self conscious as I dont want to be obviously stimmed out. Though I'm quite certain its non-obvious.
T+3:37: Starting to feel some come down effects. Primarily some tiredness. It feels like coming down from methylphenidate does, but as with the effects at this dose, a very mild variant of it.
T+4:32: Just finished masturbating (finished work around T+4:00). Was thinking over religious arguments before that. Masturbation was fine. Probably not fully come down yet, but the effects are not particularly noticeable. Even at peak which as described felt rather mild, there was no real euphoria.
Even at peak which as described felt rather mild, there was no real euphoria.
Though by the time the ball got rolling on work I did enjoy the ease with which I could focus on it.
T+4:43: Eating some fried rice for dinner. Was expecting that eating at this stage would be fine, as earlier on I could imagine eating, which on other stimms at this dose/higher doses of stimms is usually not the case for me. Though other stimms at this dosage usually seem to have stronger effects for me. This expectation was correct. The food tasted nice enough, I ate a pretty normal portion, perhaps slightly on the smaller side. It was clear I was not sober, as it felt more like a chore than a treat. And I usually really enjoy fried rice. But it was a very easy, not at all unpleasant chore. I couldve even eaten more if there was some reason to.
T+5:07: Heading out to find a rare psilocybe (psilocybe fimetaria) for my area that was reported on an observation platform Ive built a scraper and notification bot for. Going on bike. No intent to harvest nor obtain mycelium. Im already growing psilocybe cyanescens and psilocybe azurescens mycelium for mushrooms in my garden next autumn (hopefully), and dont want to commit to cultivating a dung-lover at the moment. Maybe next year.
T+6:50: Just got back. There was a fence a few hundred metres from the location. Quite possibly open during the day. I suppose Ill just have to hope the mushroom is still there and in somewhat nice condition for viewing over the weekend At least it was some exercise. As for effects there seems to be a bit of residual stimulation, very minor. Though at one point on my way back I felt some vomit coming up. No real nausea. Strange, not something I usually experience. Im a little disappointed it [going to see the mushroom] didnt work, but I did not feel like I wasted my time. Unclear if this was part of the effects of the drug or not. But I would expect I usually would struggle with such disappointment for a bit, here I was disappointed, sure, but accepted it quite easily.
T+7:04: Definitely starting to feel tired, which means this is likely the last update Im going to write. Feeling a slight headache in the back of my head and around my temples. (I dont usually experience particularly many headaches, including more minor ones like this)
T+7:46: No longer feel tired, maybe it was just from the cycling that I had a bit of an energy dip. I feel like I still feel it. Its getting kinda late. I was planning on smoking some weed anyways, so hopefully I fall asleep around the normal time for me, well see. Reflecting on how everything has gone thus far its very strange. At least at this dose the effects were never particularly pronounced in the moment. It is only now that Im trying to relax that I really actively feel the stimulation. Whenever I was doing things it was just nicer to do them, but without any particular euphoria, and without stronger stimulation, it can easily seem like Im not under the effect of any drug. Its kind of like a better caffeine in that sense. At low doses it definitely stimulates you, but if youre not paying attention it will only be after the fact youll notice you were less sleepy than youdve otherwise been. Im definitely interested in what a higher dose would do, and what a recreational (for fun) setting would do. I already had the thought to take it before work tomorrow. But I wont, this is the sort of stuff I can see myself becoming dependent and or addicted to. Perhaps next week though. In addition, by this point 2fma is no longer legally available where I live, so that makes it easier to not make a habit out of it. But generally I highly restrict my stimulant intake because, especially in lower doses it makes me function better, feel better, and just everything is nicer (except food). But that wont last, there is no good reason to chase that feeling. Better to have it a few times a year, and actually experience it imho. (And except for the possibly placebo dose of last time, its been over 3 years since the last time Id done a stimulant (a fluoridated methylphenidate, Ive also written an experience report about).
T+8:47: Definitely notice the hyperfocus yet, paradoxically when distracted focus can also quickly shift entirely. Just wanted to check out the new art materials in the Ace Attorney Trilogy update, ended up also playing through a bit of a case in Japanese (which I cannot speak nor read) as to send a video to an acquaintance who is studying Japanese, so he might explain what was likely a pun, but makes no sense.
T+9:30: Still feel quite awake, could easily stay awake. Time seems to fly when Im doing things. Going to smoke some weed now and hopefully fall asleep in an hour or so Will not write any more until tomorrow (and thus recollection based).
I ended up falling asleep at a pretty normal time for me. Did feel strangely on edge whilst drifting away. The morning after was pretty normal. I did feel a little more down and tired than I think I normally wouldve felt. But it was unclear to me at the time if this was real or was in comparison to how it felt like I could do anything the day before, and now my baseline caution was back. Regardless, once I finished my commute I was busy with other things, and thus no longer felt bad. The rest of the day was unremarkable at least in the sense that anything related to the 2fma consumption of the day prior.
